senses.gloss: to cut, chip, hew, trim. Tanḥ. ʿEḳeb 9 (ref. to Koh. III, 5) עת היה לִפְסוֹל שני וכ׳ the time came to hew other two tablets (in place of the broken).
units: <cite ref="Ecclesiastes 3:5">Ib.</cite> <he>מתחת כסא הכבוד פְּסָלָּן</he> he hewed them from under the throne of glory.

Ab. Zar. 52ᵃ (ref. to Deut. VII, 25) משפְּסָלוֹ נעשה אלוה as soon as a gentile has done chiselling on it, it becomes a deity (an idol forbidden to Jews for any use); ib. פסלו לאלוה לא וכ׳ when the gentile has hewed it for a god, thou shalt not covet it; פסלו מאלוה ולקחת לך when he chips it so as to unfit it as an idol (v. infra), thou mayest take it unto thyself; a. e.—Part. pass. פָּסוּל; f. פְּסוּלָה; pl. פְּסוּלִים, פְּסוּלִין; פְּסוּלוֹת
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 22:9">Lev. R. s. 22</cite> <he>אבנים פ׳</he> chipped stones (unfit for the altar); a. e.—

senses.gloss: (denom. of פָּסוּל) to disqualify, to be the cause of disqualification of; to declare unfit.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Chullin 3:12">Ḥull. III, 12</cite> <cite ref="Q00292"><he>פּוֹסְלִין</he></cite>, v. <cite ref="K01324"><he>כָּשֵׁר</he> I</cite>. Ab. Zar. l. c. <he>מניין לנכרי שפּוֹסֵל אלוהו</he> how will you prove that a gentile can cancel his deity (by disfiguring it)? <cite ref="Kiddushin 70a:10">Kidd. 70ᵃ</cite> <he>אוי לו לפוסל את זרעו ולפוגם וכ׳</he> woe to him who causes his descendants to be disqualified and his family to be tarnished.

<cite ref="Kiddushin 70a:11">Ib.</cite> <he>כל הפוסל פסול</he> he who tarnishes (casts suspicion on the purity of a family) is himself tarnished (of spurious descent); <he>במומו פוסל</he> he charges others with his own defect.

<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 1:25">Ex. R. s. 1</cite> <he>החזירתו … ופ׳ את כלן</he> she (Pharaoh’s daughter) took him (the infant Moses) around to all Egyptian women to give him suck, but he rejected all of them (refused to take their breasts); <he>ולמה פְסָלָן</he> and why did he reject them? <cite ref="Mishnah Sanhedrin 3:1">Snh. III, 1</cite> <he>זה פוֹסֵל דיינו של זה וכ׳</he> each has a right to reject the judge chosen by the other; <he>אם היו כשרים … אינו יכול לפוֹסְלָן</he> if they are fit (not legally disqualified) or authorized, he cannot reject them.
<cite ref="Mishnah Sanhedrin 3:1">Ib.</cite> <he>זה פוסל עדיו וכ׳</he> every witness in a case may help by his testimony to disqualify the opposing party’s witnesses.
<cite ref="Mishnah Rosh Hashanah 1:7">R. Hash. I, 7</cite> <he>קבלו … ופָסְלוּ וכ׳</he> they accepted as witnesses himself and his son, and rejected his slave.
<cite ref="Mishnah Mikvaot 2:4">Mikv. II, 4</cite> <he>פּוֹסְלִין את המקוה</he> are sufficient to make the pond unfit for ritual immersion.
<cite ref="Mishnah Mikvaot 7:5">Ib. VII, 5</cite> <he>לא פְסָלוּהוּ</he> they do not make the blood unfit.
<cite ref="Mishnah Zevachim 1:4">Zeb. I, 4</cite> <he>המחשבה פוֹסֶלֶת</he> the improper intention makes the sacrifice unfit.
Succ. II, 7, a. e. בית שמאי פוסלין the school of Sh. declares such a Succah to be ritually unfit; a. v. fr.—Trnsf. to cancel, abrogate.
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 97a:10">B. Kam. 97ᵃ</cite> <he>פְּסָלַתּוּ מלכות</he> the government cancelled the coin; <he>פסלתו מדינה</he> the inhabitants of the district refused to pass it.—

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 30:3">Gen. R. s. 30</cite>, beg. <he>כל מקום שנאמר אלה פ׳ את הראשונים וכ׳</he> wherever the Biblical text has ‘these’, it is meant to cancel (exclude) the preceding; wherever it has ‘and these’, it is to add to the preceding; <cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 1:25">Ex. R. s. 1</cite> <he>אלה תולדות</he> … <he>פ׳ וכ׳</he> ‘these are the origins of heaven and earth’ (<cite ref="Genesis 2:4">Gen. II, 4</cite>), this excludes the time of chaos; a. fr.

senses.gloss: to be hewn, sculptured. Sifra K’dosh. beg. פסל על שהם נִפְסָלִין idols are named pesel, because they are sculptured; (Yalk. Lev. 604 פסולין).
to be disqualified, made unfit, declared unfit.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Zevachim 1:4">Zeb. I, 4</cite> <he>הזבח נ׳ ארבעה וכ׳</he> a sacrifice may become unfit by improper actions in four stages, at the slaughtering &c.
<cite ref="Pesachim 15b">Pes. 15ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Pesachim 45b:3-17">45ᵇ</cite> <he>הפת … ונִפְסְלָה מלאכול</he> if bread becomes mouldy and unfit for man to eat.

<cite ref="Mishnah Tahorot 8:6">Toh. VIII, 6</cite> <he>עד שיִפָּסֵל מאוכל הכלב</he> until it becomes unfit for a dog to eat; Y. Ḥall. IV, 60ᵃ top <he>עד שתִּפְסוֹל</he>. [<cite ref="Menachot 100a:5">Men. 100ᵃ</cite>, v. <cite ref="Q01239"><he>פְּסוֹל</he></cite>.] <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 6:8">Num. R. s. 6</cite> end <he>לא היו נִפְסָלִים אלא בקול</he> they (the Levites) became unfit for service only when they lost their voice for song.

B. Kam. IX, 2 נִפְסְלָה מעל גבי המזבח became unfit for the altar; a. fr.—Trnsf. to be cancelled, abrogated. B. Kam. l. c. מטבע ונ׳ (גזל) if one stole a coin, and it was invalidated (before he made the restitution).

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 104b:10">Snh. 104ᵇ</cite> (expl. <he>סִלָּה</he>, <cite ref="Lamentations 1:15">Lam. I, 15</cite>) <he>כאדם שאומר לחברו נפסלה מטבע זו</he> as one says to his neighbor, this coin is worthless; v. <cite ref="O00952"><he>סָלָא</he></cite>; a. e.

senses.gloss: to cut off dry twigs, to trim.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Sheviit 2:3">Shebi. II, 3</cite> <he>מְפַסְּלִין עד וכ׳</he> (in the ante-Sabbatical year) you may trim trees up to New Year, v. <cite ref="Q00748"><he>פִּיסּוּל</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Mikvaot 9:7">Mikv. IX, 7</cite> <he>מְפַסְּלי אילנות</he> trimmers of trees. Y. Sabb. VII, 10ᵃ top; a. e.—

<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 942:36">Yalk. Deut. 942</cite> <he>מְפַסְּלוֹ במעצד</he> he chips it (the crooked staff) with the adze; Sifré <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 308">ib. 308</cite> <he>מפתלו</he> (corr. acc.).

<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 11:9:1">Koh. R. to XI, 9</cite> <he>שהיה מַפְסִיל בנשים וכ׳</he> who used to find fault with women (considering none good enough for him as wife), and was a profligate.—[Part. pass. <he>מוּפְסָל</he>, v. next w.]
